title: Coop-IDE (Harbor) Architecture Plan
description: A structured plan for a slice of the M-Agent + N-Human cooperative IDE (the Harbor), so this skill's phased Quality Gates and four anti-patterns can be checked deterministically by scripts/coop_ide_audit.mjs.

surface.description: Name of the collaborative surface or slice this plan covers, e.g. 'editor', 'quay', 'transcript-diff'.

actorsArePeers.description: True if every actor (human or agent) is a Loro replica with a PeerID minted from its PD identity, rendered identically with provenance -- agents are peers, not tools.

claimsGateEdits.description: True if claims and POST /conflicts/predict gate edits above the CRDT, surfacing a Conflicted/Gated band before any byte is written, instead of trusting Loro's auto-merge for correctness.

salvageImplemented.description: True if salvage is implemented: a dead replica's op-log and claim persist and can be replayed so a successor inherits and finishes -- not deferred away.

daemonIsCollabServer.description: True if the existing daemon is the collab server (Loro Protocol over the existing tube; checkpoint/reconnect through the canonical editor-sync contract; salvage through typed operation receipts, never notes) with no new sync backend stood up.

topologyBehindTransportTrait.description: True if Shared (daemon HTTP+SSE) / LAN (iroh) / Remote (relay+E2E) topology is abstracted behind a single SyncTransport trait so the editor never branches on which transport it runs over.

bufferBeforeTransport.description: True if the buffer and coordination (P1-P3: skeleton, buffer, agents+claims, salvage) were built and proven before transport polish (P4 shared, P5 remote) -- guards against the 'transport-first' anti-pattern.

surfaceComposesSiblings.description: True if this surface composes the critical sibling skills (rust-gpui-motion, gpui-shaders, vello-parley-rendering, metal-text-pipeline, gpui-rust-console) for its layer instead of reinventing their concerns inline.

visualArtifactsInTestPlan.description: True if the PR test plan for this UI merge includes a screenshot and a motion clip (e.g. board->steer->diff), per the standing 'no UI merges without visual artifacts' rule.
